# Temporary landscape

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool for this website. This is an imagined
scene, not a real location. The original 1200 × 600 exports remain as `assets/lakeside-computer.webp` and
`assets/lakeside-computer.jpg` (the social preview). The interactive page uses
`assets/lake-720.webp` and `assets/lake-1440.webp`, imported unchanged from the
`design/lake-ripple` worktree. These are 720 × 360 and 1440 × 720 versions of the
lake composition. Its water outline and screen mask are calibrated in
`assets/lake-ripple.js`. Replace the image and retune those coordinates together;
update the alt text and social preview if the subject changes.

## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for an understated personal website, approximately 2:1 landscape composition. Create an original quiet nature-and-technology scene: an old small cream CRT desktop computer sitting low among meadow grasses and tiny wildflowers beside a still lake, distant wooded hills, airy cloudy sky. The computer is a subtle discovery, not a product hero, positioned slightly to the right of centre in the lower half. Entire scene rendered as fine monochrome stippling and old Macintosh-style error-diffusion dither, black and muted olive-grey ink on warm near-white paper. Rich readable landscape forms with fine visible dots, restrained contrast, delicate atmospheric distance, calm and curious, sophisticated analogue printed texture. No people, no text, no logos, no UI, no border, no typography, no luminous neon, no science fiction architecture. Edge-to-edge landscape; do not show a website mockup.
